market_definition: The fluoroelastomer foam market comprises specialty foams from FKM fluoropolymer rubber used in demanding chemical and thermal environments. It measures sales of FKM foam sheets, gaskets and seals. BY PRODUCT FORM: Sheets, Gaskets & Seals, Tubes. BY CELL STRUCTURE: Closed-Cell, Open-Cell. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Aerospace & Defense, Oil, Gas & Chemical Processing, Automotive Fuel & Powertrain Systems, Semiconductor Equipment, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: PVDF foam; silicone and EPDM foams; solid FKM O-rings and seals. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
